prompt: I know I'm not supposed to spend too much on a gym membership, but I need to get back into shape after the baby, you know? Do you know if that's a lot to spend?
I know it's crazy to spend so much on a birthday party, but my sister's 30th is next weekend and I really want to throw her a big one, you know?

I know I'm being stupid, but I just got into a fight with my sister over a stupid misunderstanding, and now I'm feeling super anxious about it. I know we'll talk it out eventually, but it's hard not to wonder if I said something to hurt her feelings. Do you know how to deal with those kinds of arguments when you're feeling really emotional?
I know it's been a long day, but I'm really struggling to fall asleep tonight. My grandma's funeral is tomorrow and I'm just feeling so overwhelmed, you know?
I know my partner's always saying I'm too perfectionistic, but honestly, can you even get a good cup of coffee if you don't follow a recipe to the letter? You know?

I know I should be more organized, but I just got a bunch of bills and receipts from my vacation and now my wallet is super cluttered. I know I need to clean it out, but where do I even start? Do you know, or do you think I should just make a list?
I know it sounds silly, but I really miss our Sunday night walks when the kids were still little. Now it's just me and the dog. You know?

I know my sister's always on my case about my job, saying I should be doing something more 'stable' or 'secure', but you know, I've been thinking about starting my own business for years, and I'm finally at the point where I can take the leap, I know it's scary but what if I fail, you know?

I know the new restaurant that just opened downtown is supposed to be amazing, but I'm not sure if I can afford it. My budget is really tight this month and I don't want to go in there and be awkward if I have to leave early, you know?

I know I'm being really selfish, but I just found out my ex is getting married and I'm feeling super bitter, you know? I know I should just be happy for her, but every time I see her on social media, I just can't help but feel like I'm missing out on something that could've been with me. Do you know how to get over feelings like this? Or is it just something I'll never get over?
I know everyone says you're supposed to take breaks from social media, but I've been trying to limit my use to 2 hours a day and I'm not sure if that's enough, you know?

I know I've been putting off this for way too long, and I'm starting to feel like I'm failing at my own life, you know? I've been trying to get into this new hobby I've been interested in for months, but every time I try to start, I just end up getting distracted by work or other stuff, you know? Is it normal for people to just give up on things they want to do because of their daily routine? Or am I just not motivated enough? Do you know if there's any way to make myself more consistent with it?

I know I'm a total mess when it comes to houseplants, but I'm trying to start a small herb garden in my backyard and I'm really struggling to keep the soil moist. I know I need to get a irrigation system, but I'm not sure where to start, you know?

I know my kid is obsessed with this one kid from school, and I know it's just a phase, but it's getting old, you know? They're spending more and more time just watching him play soccer, and I'm worried it's going to impact their own interests and friendships, you know?

I know my partner is always saying I need to be more organized, but honestly, I feel like I'm doing okay, you know? I mean, I get everything done on time, but sometimes it feels like I'm just trying to please him instead of myself, you know?

I know I'm trying to cut back on eating out, but it's just so hard when everyone I work with is always grabbing lunch at this one place downtown. I know it's supposed to be healthy, but every time I go, it feels like a social obligation or something. Do you know, am I just being lazy or is it actually hard to stick to a new diet when it's all social?

I know I've been putting off my car maintenance for ages, and now I'm worried I might have blown the engine. I've been meaning to take it to the mechanic, but every time I try to schedule an appointment, I end up getting bogged down with work or other stuff. You know, I feel like I'm just delaying the inevitable. Do you know what the typical cost is for repairing a blown engine? Or is it usually worth trying to fix it? I know I should probably just take it in, but what if I get ripped off by the mechanic?

I know it sounds weird, but I just can't seem to find a yoga class in my area that actually teaches vinyasa flow without, you know, all the extra modifications and beginner-friendly nonsense. I know I'm not the only one who's searching for a more challenging practice, right?

I know I've been putting off learning how to code for months now, and my friends keep telling me I should just take an online course, but I don't know if I can do it, you know? I mean, I've always been really good at school, but this feels like something completely different. Do you know if it's even possible for someone like me to learn to code at my age, or am I just being stupid for even trying? You know?

I know it sounds like I'm being paranoid, but I've been noticing a weird pattern with my bills lately. Every time I get a large payment, the next month's bills are suddenly thousands of dollars higher. Do you know if this is some kind of scam or is it just standard accounting practice?

I know I've been feeling really overwhelmed with work lately, you know? I know my boss has been breathing down my neck about meeting these impossible deadlines, but what if I tell him no, you know? What if I just quit my job and focus on my own projects for once? I know it sounds crazy, but you know, I just feel like I'm not being true to myself, and I'm tired of feeling like I'm just going through the motions every day.

I know I'm supposed to start a new exercise routine next week, but I've been feeling so overwhelmed with work and I'm already behind on my personal projects. Do you know if it's even worth trying to start now or should I just put it off until next month, you know?

I know it sounds silly, but I'm really struggling to find a new apartment that's within my budget. I've been looking for weeks and every place I find is either way out of range or falling apart, you know? I feel like I'm failing at adulting. Do you know if that's just a normal part of the process?

I know I should be excited about my upcoming vacation, but every time I look at the itinerary, I feel anxious about trying all the new activities and feeling out of shape. You know? Should I just stick to the hotel pool and the beach, or try to push myself a bit more?

I know I've been putting off buying a new car for months, but you know? I know I need something reliable, but my old one is still running well and I don't want to waste all that money, you know? I know some people say it's a bad idea to keep an old car for too long, but you know, I just can't seem to find the right deal on a new one, and I don't want to get taken advantage of. Do you know if I'm being too picky or should I just settle for something that's 'good enough'? You know?

I know I've been trying to cut back on social media lately, you know? I know my friends always seem to be posting these amazing vacation photos, and it's making me feel really bad about myself. I know I've been using it as a way to avoid dealing with some deeper issues, but you know, it's hard to just turn off the notifications and pretend everything is okay. I mean, what if I'm just setting myself up for disappointment, you know? What if I start to feel like I'm not good enough, just because I'm not as successful or as happy as everyone else is posting? You know?

I know it's been a long week, but I'm really frustrated with my job situation. I've been passed over for promotions twice now and I'm starting to feel like I'm not learning or growing in my role, you know? I know I should probably just be grateful for a steady paycheck, but it's hard not to feel like I'm stuck in a rut, you know?

I know it's been a while since I got back into cooking after college, but I'm really struggling to find recipes that aren't super basic and boring, you know? I mean, I know there are like, a million million variations of pasta sauces out there, but every time I try to get creative, it just ends up tasting like spaghetti, you know?
I know I'm trying to cut down on screen time before bed, but I just can't seem to stop scrolling through social media for like 20 minutes every night, you know?

I know I should be excited about my upcoming trip to visit my family, but honestly, I'm just really nervous about meeting all of their kids for the first time. I don't know if I'm ready for all the questions and attention. Do you know if it's weird to be feeling this way about a family vacation?

I know I'm supposed to start going to the gym more often, but it feels like every gym is either super expensive or has a waiting list that's just ridiculous, you know? I feel like I'm not getting any younger and I just don't know how to make time for it without it feeling like another chore, I guess.

I know it's been a few weeks since I got my promotion, but I'm still really struggling to find a new place to live. Everyone I know is either moving to the suburbs or wanting me to rent from someone I don't even know, you know?

I know it sounds weird, but I've been having these weird dreams lately that feel really real. Last night I dreamt I was standing in an empty classroom and my teacher just walked in and started teaching me a subject I had never learned before. I know it's just a dream, but it felt so vivid and realistic, you know? I've been trying to brush it off as just my brain being weird, but I keep feeling like there's something more to it.

I know I've been putting off getting a new job for months now, and I know I need to do something about it, but every time I start looking, I end up feeling so overwhelmed and stuck, you know? I know I have the skills and experience, but I'm just not sure where to start or what type of job is right for me. I know I need to take the leap and apply to some places, but it's just so scary, you know?
I know I should be doing more exercise, but the thought of going to the gym every day makes me feel like I'm failing at everything else in my life, you know?

I know I'm supposed to be more organized with my finances, but I feel so overwhelmed with all the bills and stuff. You know? I've been trying to cut back on unnecessary expenses, but it feels like I'm just making the same old mistakes over and over. Do you know if it's normal to just feel like that all the time? Or am I just not doing something right?

I know it's been ages since I last traveled, but you know? I've been feeling really stuck in a rut and I'm trying to decide whether to take that trip I've been planning for months to visit my family in Europe. I know it would be great for my mental health and would be a great opportunity to recharge, but you know? I'm also really scared of flying again after that terrible experience last year. Do you know if I'm overthinking it or should I just take the chance and book the ticket?

I know I'm not a big fan of surprises, but my wife is planning a trip to my hometown for our anniversary, and I'm feeling really nervous about the trip, you know? I know I'll have a great time, but it's just that it's a big change of pace for me, and I'm worried that I'll get lost or do something embarrassing, and I know we'll have a great time together, but I just want to make sure I'm prepared, can you know what kind of things I should expect or prepare for?

I know I'm being super lazy, but I'm just so overwhelmed with work and life right now and I need a break from everything, including cleaning and cooking, you know? I feel like I'm just going through the motions and I don't know how to make myself start doing anything productive again. Do you know if that's just burnout or something else?

I know I'm really overwhelmed with school loans and credit card debt, you know? I know I should be more aggressive with my payments, but I just got a raise and I'm not sure if I should put all of it towards the debt or cut myself some slack and enjoy my new life, you know?

I know I should start taking yoga classes more often, but every time I've tried to sign up for a studio class, I end up feeling self-conscious about my body, you know? Like, I'll be standing there on the mat trying to touch my toes and everyone else will be, like, super flexible and I'll just feel like I'm stuck, you know?

I know it's been hard to find time for hobbies lately, but I've been wanting to try painting again and you know? I remember how much I enjoyed it in high school, but then I stopped after I got into college and never had the time or motivation to pick it up again. I know some people are naturally more artistic than others, but I feel like I still have a creative side and I'm wondering if I should just get some art supplies and try again, even if I'm probably going to be terrible at it.

I know I've been putting it off for weeks, but I still haven't finished planning my trip to Europe next summer. I know I have all the information and it's just a matter of making a schedule, but every time I try to make one, I get overwhelmed and it ends up looking like a list of things I need to do rather than a real plan, you know?

I know I've been avoiding calling my mom again, you know? I know we haven't talked in months, and I know she's probably worried about me, but every time I try to pick up the phone, I feel like I'm just going to get stuck on some long lecture about my life choices, and I know she'll still be disappointed with my decisions, and honestly, I just don't know how to break the news to her about my recent breakup, you know?

I know I should really start learning how to code again, but I just can't seem to get motivated, you know? Everyone around me is always talking about the job opportunities and I feel like I'm missing out if I don't pick it up.
